text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: 16 tests, all OK. I didn't change any tests. The fixes, all in `catalog/`:

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an int.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily fee to the days late. It now multiplies them.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` sliced `[-n - 1:]`, which returned one event too many. It now slices `[-n:]`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5. The comment and the tests both say five books, and the code had 3.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` now includes `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The docstring and the tests expect three books.

I made up the `Emma` details (author, year and copy count) because the tests only check the title.
